verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਉਪਬਨ ਆਂਬ ਸੇਂਬਲ ਹੈ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise upaban aa(n)b se(n)bal hai uooch neech nihafal safal pragaT pahichaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as there are mango and silk cotton trees in the same garden, but a mango tree is more respected because of the fruits that it yields, whereas the Silk cotton tree being without fruits is considered inferior.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਂਸ ਅਉ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਗੰਧ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan sameep jaise baa(n)s aau banaasapatee ga(n)dh niraga(n)dh siv sakat kai jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as in a jungle, there are sandalwood and bamboo trees. Since bamboo remains devoid of fragrance is known as egoistic and proud, whereas others absorb sandalwood's fragrance and are considered peace and comfort-giving trees.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੀਪ ਸੰਖ ਦੋਊ ਜੈਸੇ ਰਹਿਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਨ ਸਮਤ ਬਿਧਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: seep sa(n)kh dhouoo jaise rahit samu(n)dhr bikhai savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh sa(n)tat na samat bidhaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as an oyster and conch shell are found in the same sea but oyster accepting ambrosial drop of rain water yields a pearl whereas a conch shell remains useless. Thus both cannot be graded equal.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕਨ ਭੇਦ ਅਹੰ ਬੁਧਿ ਨਿਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਅਮਾਨ ਜਗ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੪੬੫॥
verses.translit_en: taise gurdhev aan dhev sevakan bhedh aha(n) budh nimrataa amaan jag maaneeaai ||465||

en.bdb: Similarly there is a difference between the devotees of the True Guru-the blesser of truth, and gods and goddesses. The followers of gods are proud of their intellect whereas the disciples of True Guru are considered humble and non-arrogant by the world.  (465)
